info.title: MICROSERVICE-apiwizruntimedoc-List Pharmacy Prescriptions Status-v4-spec
info.description: The Pharmacy Prescription Status API provides access to the current status of pharmacy prescriptions. This endpoint allows users to retrieve detailed information on the status of their prescriptions, making it ideal for healthcare providers and patients who want to track medication fulfillment. By querying the status, stakeholders can take informed actions regarding prescription pickup, refills, or any necessary follow-ups with pharmacies. This functionality supports better medication management and enhances overall patient care.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch the current status of prescriptions for a patient. It provides insights into whether prescriptions are active, completed, or require attention.

requestBody.description: Request body for retrieving the status of prescriptions. This body should include the necessary parameters to filter or identify the prescriptions you are querying about.
